name: Introduction to Sensors Technology
description: Basics of sensors and transducers, sensor characteristics; materials and processes for sensor development; physical principles of sensing - resistive, capacitive, magnetic, piezoelectric effect, pyroelectric effect, thermoelectric effect, hall effect; static and dynamical models of sensors; pressure, force and strain sensing, tactile sensing; inertial sensing; acoustic sensing; RF and acoustic coherent sensing; powering the sensors - energy harvesting and wireless power transfer; flexible and stretchable sensors - applications in wearable and biomedical systems; sensor and data fusion - neuromorphic sensing; interface electronic circuits - use cases.
